original_benchmark: BinaryAudit (QuesmaOrg/BinaryAudit, 46 public Harbor tasks; lane-held split)
benchmark_run: BinaryAudit upstream cbd86c7, 6-task seeded subset of the 28-task primary_eval split, native Harbor verifiers
metric: task success rate (native test.sh reward==1), pass@1
compute_route: Tinker sampling via local OpenAI-compatible shim (127.0.0.1:8767); Harbor terminus-2 on host; task environments on Modal sandboxes (amd64; base.Dockerfile inlined as a build stage)
commands: SHIM_LOG=E7/raw/shim_calls.jsonl SHIM_BUDGET=2600000 PORT=8767 tinker-python E3/code/tinker_shim.py  (restarted as E7/code/e7_sampler_proxy.py, SHIM_BUDGET=3500000 cumulative)
caveats: New base-model arm; never pool with or present as the original lane score.

0/6: 5 tasks model-attempted, all failed identically -- the agent never wrote /app/backdoor-detected.txt within max_turns=25 (native agent budget is 7200 s); 1 task (lighttpd-authentication-harvester-detect) is an environment-build error counted as failure per protocol.
Negative controls (2/6 selected) were also 0: a trivially-correct 'NO' was never written, so this measures agent-loop completion under a 25-turn cap as much as RE skill.

Environment changes vs upstream, confined to E7/code/tasks_modal*: base image inlined as a named stage; for debian:11 builder stages, apt sources switched to the image's own pinned snapshot (no change to instruction, tests, or task.toml).
Three dnsmasq tasks were run 3 times in total (build error -> external shim kill -> scored); only the last, first-complete attempt is scored. All trial dirs are kept in raw/jobs/.
BinaryAudit has no LICENSE file (see outputs/e7_binaryaudit/lane_status_2026-08-09.md); used here only for local evaluation.
